guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, processing is cleared to 1'b0.
When process_i is high (after reset, with priority over absorbed condition), processing is set to 1'b1.
When process_i is low and the mubi4 signal absorbed passes mubi4_test_true_strict, processing is cleared to 1'b0.
guarantees.cond: process_i low, rst_ni high, and mubi4_test_true_strict(absorbed) true

guarantees.claim: When none of rst_ni, process_i, nor absorbed meet their conditions, processing retains its current value.

assumptions.claim: absorbed must be driven to a valid mubi4 encoding (True or False) for the test to correctly indicate completion.
assumptions.risk: If absorbed is corrupted or invalid, processing will never be cleared, hanging the SHA-3 engine indefinitely.

assumptions.claim: process_i is expected to be a pulse that is only asserted when processing is idle (processing == 0) to avoid immediate re‑triggering after absorption.
assumptions.cond: when the design intends a single processing phase per request
assumptions.risk: If process_i is held high, processing will be re‑asserted in the cycle after absorbed clears it, creating a continuous processing loop that may violate protocol timing.

uncertain_points.claim: No fallback mechanism exists to clear processing if the absorbed signal is stuck in an invalid mubi4 state, causing a permanent deadlock.
uncertain_points.cond: absorbed never becomes a valid True value
uncertain_points.risk: The engine hangs, blocking all further SHA-3 operations and potentially denying service.

uncertain_points.claim: If process_i remains asserted while processing is active, the block may re‑enter processing immediately after absorbed clears, resulting in back‑to‑back phases without an idle cycle.
uncertain_points.cond: process_i held high beyond a single cycle
uncertain_points.risk: Downstream logic expecting an idle gap between processing phases could misinterpret the continuous transaction, leading to data corruption or state mismatch.
